   145	def sinkhorn_algorithm(
   146	        distances,
   147	        epsilon,
   148	        sinkhorn_iterations): 
   149	    Q = torch.exp(- distances / epsilon)
   150	
   151	    B = Q.shape[0] # number of samples to assign
   152	    K = Q.shape[1] # how many centroids per block (usually set to 256)
   153	
   154	    sum_Q = Q.sum(-1, keepdim=True).sum(-2, keepdim=True)
   155	    Q /= sum_Q
   156	
   157	    for it in range(sinkhorn_iterations):
   158	        # normalize each column: total weight per sample must be 1/B
   159	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=1, keepdim=True)
   160	        Q /= B
   161	        # normalize each row: total weight per prototype must be 1/K
   162	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=0, keepdim=True)
   163	        Q /= K
   164	    Q *= B # the colomns must sum to 1 so that Q is an assignment
   165	    return Q

   219	        max_distance = distances.max()

   221	        #print(max_distance, min_distance)

   237	        codebook_h = proj_to_ball(expmap0(codebook, self.c), self.c)  #(codebook_size, e_dim)

   240	        K = codebook_h.shape[0]
   241	
   242	        x_exp = latent_h.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, K, -1)      # (B, K, D+1)
   243	        cb_exp = codebook_h.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, K, -1)

   258

   272	        latent = logmap0(latent, self.c)
   273	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()

   279	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   280	        '''

   129	        samples,
   130	        num_clusters,
   131	        num_iterations=10):
   132	    device = samples.device
   133	    x = samples.cpu().detach().numpy()
   134

   145	def sinkhorn_algorithm(
   146	        distances,
   147	        epsilon,
   148	        sinkhorn_iterations): 
   149	    Q = torch.exp(- distances / epsilon)
   150	
   151	    B = Q.shape[0] # number of samples to assign
   152	    K = Q.shape[1] # how many centroids per block (usually set to 256)
   153	
   154	    sum_Q = Q.sum(-1, keepdim=True).sum(-2, keepdim=True)
   155	    Q /= sum_Q
   156	
   157	    for it in range(sinkhorn_iterations):
   158	        # normalize each column: total weight per sample must be 1/B
   159	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=1, keepdim=True)
   160	        Q /= B
   161	        # normalize each row: total weight per prototype must be 1/K
   162	        Q /= torch.sum(Q, dim=0, keepdim=True)
   163	        Q /= K
   164	    Q *= B # the colomns must sum to 1 so that Q is an assignment
   165	    return Q

   216	    @staticmethod
   217	    def center_distance_for_constraint(distances):
   218	        
   219	        max_distance = distances.max()
   220	        min_distance = distances.min()
   221	        #print(max_distance, min_distance)
   222	
   223	        middle = (max_distance + min_distance) / 2
   224	        amplitude = max_distance - middle + 1e-10
   225	        assert amplitude > 0, "Amplitude must be positive"
   226	        centered_distances = (distances - middle) / amplitude
   227	
   228	        return centered_distances

   230	    def forward(self, x, use_sk=True):
   231	        latent = x.view(-1, self.e_dim)
   232	        codebook = self.embeddings.weight  #(codebook_size, e_dim)
   233	        if not self.initted and self.training:
   234	            self.init_emb(latent)
   235	        
   236	        latent_h = proj_to_ball(expmap0(latent, self.c), self.c)   #(Batch_size, e_dim)
   237	        codebook_h = proj_to_ball(expmap0(codebook, self.c), self.c)  #(codebook_size, e_dim)
   238	
   239	        B = latent_h.shape[0]
   240	        K = codebook_h.shape[0]
   241	
   242	        x_exp = latent_h.unsqueeze(1).expand(B, K, -1)      # (B, K, D+1)
   243	        cb_exp = codebook_h.unsqueeze(0).expand(B, K, -1)
   244	        
   245	        d = poincare_distance(x_exp, cb_exp, self.c).squeeze(-1) # (B,K)
   246	        #d = torch.nn.functional.normalize(d, p=2, dim=-1)
   247	        
   248	        if not use_sk or self.sk_eps <= 0:
   249	            indices = torch.argmin(d, dim=-1)
   250	        else:
   251	            d_centered = self.center_distance_for_constraint(d)
   252	            d_centered = d_centered.double()
   253	            Q = sinkhorn_algorithm(
   254	                d_centered, 
   255	                self.sk_eps, 
   256	                self.sk_iters
   257	            )
   258	
   259	            if torch.isnan(Q).any() or torch.isinf(Q).any():
   260	                raise ValueError("Sinkhorn algorithm produced NaN or Inf values.")
   261	            indices = torch.argmax(Q, dim=-1)
   262	        x_exp = logmap0(x_exp, self.c)
   263	        cb_exp = logmap0(cb_exp, self.c)
   264	        x_q = codebook.index_select(0, indices)
   265	        
   266	        commitment_loss = torch.mean(poincare_distance(x_q.detach(), latent, self.c)**2)
   267	        codebook_loss = torch.mean(poincare_distance(x_q, latent.detach(), self.c)**2)
   268	        
   269	        loss = commitment_loss + self.beta * codebook_loss
   270	        
   271	        x_q = logmap0(x_q, self.c)
   272	        latent = logmap0(latent, self.c)
   273	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   274	        '''
   275	        x_q = self.embeddings(indices).view(x.shape)
   276	        commitment_loss = F.mse_loss(x_q.detach(), latent)
   277	        codebook_loss = F.mse_loss(x_q, latent.detach())
   278	        loss = commitment_loss + self.beta * codebook_loss
   279	        x_q = x + (x_q - x).detach()
   280	        '''
   281	        indices = indices.view(x.shape[:-1])
   282	        return x_q, loss, indices

   185	    if tokens.ndim != 2 or tokens.shape[1] != len(codebook_sizes):

   194	            result[item_id, :-1] = np.asarray(row, dtype=np.int64)
   195	            result[item_id, -1] = int(offsets[-1] + occurrence)
